DecisionRecord.title: Decision Record
DecisionRecord.description: A record of a user's decision input and the AI's analysis results.

userId.description: The UID of the user who made the decision.

problem.description: The specific question or problem being analyzed.

situation.description: The background context or situation provided by the user.

values.description: The priority values selected by the user.

framework.description: The decision framework/perspective used for analysis.

inputAlternatives.description: The alternatives as input by the user.

analysis.description: The analysis results generated by the AI.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.
